testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/pending-payment-validate.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Pending Payment > validate pending payment functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in registered user opens Pending Payment, checks filters and columns, pages through the account's pending-payment orders (8 per page, total recorded), checks the total, sorts by pending order id and amount, checks junk filters give no records, and opens one pending-payment order's details.
steps: Open Pending Payment; check heading, filter options and column headers
Page size defaultPageSize: footer '1 - 8 of totalPendingPayment'; next page: '9 - total of total'
Page size largePageSize: row count equals the footer total equals totalPendingPayment
Sort by PendingOrderId asc/desc: first row equals the recorded ids
Sort by PendingOrderAmount asc/desc: amounts monotonic; recorded anchors only warned
Filter Customer Name, Account Name, Pending Order Status, Pending Order Amount by invalidSearchText: 'No records found.'
Open PendingOrderNumber's details: heading, id contains DescendingPendingOrderID, status, date; total is currency (recorded total only warned)
stateChanges: None: pending-payment orders are only read
assertions: First row after id sort equals the recorded ids
Details heading, id, status 'PENDING PAYMENT', date
evidence: Title 'validate pending payment functionality' and the step labels match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts, AUTH_SPECS my-account/**) signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, whose account is getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, set in the git-ignored .env.<env>, not in the test's JSON). Source 0 records that credential (masked). The test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) before its first step (the same account as the session)

Store MaxwellsHardware: webstore-auth uses testimEnv.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, default webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; the account's recorded records (orders, saved carts) are on PortalId 7 = MaxwellsHardware (tda rows)

OWNERSHIP: the pending-payment orders are the signed-in account's (tda rows: AR-01102025-0061 is ZnodeOrder ClassId 7 = ZnodeCPOrderClass ApprovalRoutings, OmsOrderStateId 190 = PENDING PAYMENT, UserId 16405, PortalId 7). They must be a need linked owner -> @user.userId

MISSING KEY: no vocabulary key covers a pending-payment order of the account. Proposed ORDER_OF_USER_PENDING_PAYMENT (entity order; ownerUserId {owner}, optional guarded param linked to @user.userId; order class ApprovalRoutings; order state PENDING PAYMENT; owner's pending-payment count between {minPendingPayments} and {maxPendingPayments}; scope store; outputs orderNumber, orderDate (MM/DD/YY as shown), total, pendingPaymentCount, firstOrderNumberAsc, firstOrderNumberDesc). Until it exists the need is left out and PendingOrderNumber (which the test opens) is kept as expected-output; with the key: PendingOrderNumber -> orderNumber, PendingOrderDate -> orderDate, totalPendingPayment -> pendingPaymentCount, Ascending/DescendingPendingOrderID -> the first ids

totalPendingPayment 10 with page size 8: the pagination step needs 9 to 16 pending-payment orders (two pages); the count, the id anchors, date and total depend on the account's data. The amount anchors and the order total are only warned on drift; DescendingPendingOrderID is asserted on the details page (the spec uses it where PendingOrderNumber is meant; both are AR-01102025-0061)
defaultPageSize, largePageSize, invalidSearchText and the sortAscending column names are config
migrate: the pending-payment need will link to the declared account; the counts and anchors depend on the data

Re-mapped to new keys (2026-11-01): pendingPayment = ORDER_OF_USER_PENDING_PAYMENT (owner @user.userId, minPendingPayments 9 so the 8-row page has a second page, maxPendingPayments 64 = largePageSize, store): totalPendingPayment -> pendingPaymentCount, Ascending/DescendingPendingOrderID -> firstOrderNumberAsc/Desc, PendingOrderNumber -> orderNumber, PendingOrderDate -> orderDate, PendingOrderTotal -> total (names from the key description, the pending_payment_order entity map and the drafting proposal). NOTE for migration: the spec opens PendingOrderNumber but asserts the receipt number against DescendingPendingOrderID (equal today); the migrated spec should assert the opened orderNumber. PendingOrderStatus stays expected-output (constant PENDING PAYMENT); the amount anchors stay expected-output (the key has no amount anchors; the spec checks the amounts are sorted). Strategy migrate
